hampi.name: Virupaksha Temple
hampi.description: 7th-century active Hindu temple complex dedicated to Lord Shiva, renowned for its 50-meter majestic gopuram and intricate stone carvings.
hampi.cultural_relevance: UNESCO World Heritage Site; continuous worship center since the Vijayanagara Empire.

hampi.name: Vithala Temple & Stone Chariot
hampi.description: Iconic 16th-century architectural masterpiece famous for its musical pillars and the world-renowned Stone Chariot.
hampi.cultural_relevance: Peak architectural achievement of the Vijayanagara Dynasty, depicted on Indian currency.

hampi.name: Lotus Mahal & Elephant Stables
hampi.description: Secular royal pavilion featuring two-story Indo-Islamic architecture surrounded by manicured lawns and grand elephant quarters.
hampi.cultural_relevance: Demonstrates peaceful blend of Hindu and Islamic architectural traditions.

jaipur.name: Amber Fort (Amer Fort)
jaipur.description: Majestic hilltop fortress built of red sandstone and marble overlooking Maota Lake, famous for Sheesh Mahal (Mirror Palace).
jaipur.cultural_relevance: Seat of Rajput royalty for centuries; classic Rajput architecture.

jaipur.name: Hawa Mahal (Palace of Winds)
jaipur.description: Five-story pink sandstone palace adorned with 953 honeycomb windows (jharokhas) designed for royal ladies to observe street life.
jaipur.cultural_relevance: Symbol of Pink City Jaipur built by Maharaja Sawai Pratap Singh in 1799.

jaipur.name: Jantar Mantar Observatory
jaipur.description: Astronomical observation site completed in 1734 featuring nineteen architectural instruments including the world's largest stone sundial.
jaipur.cultural_relevance: UNESCO World Heritage Site representing astronomical knowledge in 18th-century India.

varanasi.name: Dashashwamedh Ghat
varanasi.description: The main and most vibrant riverbank ghat on the sacred Ganges River, celebrated for its daily evening Ganga Aarti ceremony.
varanasi.cultural_relevance: Spiritual epicenter of Varanasi; continuous rituals performed since ancient antiquity.

varanasi.name: Kashi Vishwanath Temple
varanasi.description: One of the twelve sacred Jyotirlingas dedicated to Lord Shiva, featuring gold-plated spires and ancient corridor complex.
varanasi.cultural_relevance: One of the holiest shrines in Hinduism with thousands of years of recorded pilgrimage.

agra.name: Taj Mahal
agra.description: Immense white marble mausoleum built between 1631 and 1648 by Mughal emperor Shah Jahan in memory of his beloved wife Mumtaz Mahal.
agra.cultural_relevance: New 7 Wonders of the World and UNESCO World Heritage jewel of Muslim art in India.

agra.name: Agra Fort
agra.description: Massive 16th-century red sandstone fortress housing royal palaces like Jahangir Palace and Khas Mahal.
agra.cultural_relevance: Main residence of the Mughal emperors until 1638.

rome.name: Colosseum
rome.description: Iconic oval amphitheatre in the center of Rome, the largest ancient amphitheatre ever built.
rome.cultural_relevance: Symbol of the Roman Empire, gladiatorial history, and architectural grandeur.

rome.name: Pantheon
rome.description: Former Roman temple, now a Catholic church, boasting the world's largest unreinforced concrete dome.
rome.cultural_relevance: Best preserved ancient Roman building in continuous use for almost 2,000 years.
